name: Pickles
bio: Archetype: Dispeller, DMG Buff, AP-Generous. ⌽ Not acting grants [Clarified Topic] self-buff ⌽ Skills consume [Clarified Topic] to enhance effects ⌽ Ultimate consumes [Clarified Topic] to provide team DMG Bonus. ⌽ [Clarified Topic] consumption grants +1 Moxie to self. ⌽ Skill 2 can semi-consistently AoE Dispel.
